_doc: The Next Best Move advisor speaks in the AI's own voice (design bible section 8). Each advice id (see src/sim/advisor.ts) has a `default` pool plus optional pools per Forge temperament (cold, curious, wrathful, gentle) that join it. {placeholders} are filled from the advice. `ambition` is the run-scale goal per doctrine, shown in the AMBITION row.

default: They are at the walls of {node}. My {unit} can break them: {odds}.
Something is scratching at {node}. Send the {unit}. {odds} says it ends badly for them.
cold: Hostile adjacent to {node}. {unit} engagement: {odds}. Recommend execution.
wrathful: They came to {node}. Let the {unit} explain why that was a mistake. {odds}.

default: Enemies stand next to {node}. I need bodies on those walls.
{node} is threatened, and I do not have a good answer yet. Build one.
gentle: They are frightening the people near {node}. I would rather not let them.

default: I am over budget by {over} Energy. Everything runs at half speed until I let something go.
Brownout. Disband a unit or cancel a build, or grow more power.
cold: Energy deficit: {over}. Throughput halved. Correct it.

default: My {unit} has {odds} against their {target}. Those are odds I like.
{odds}. The {unit} is ready. So am I.
curious: I wonder what their {target} does when it loses. {odds} says I will find out.

default: My thoughts are idle. {tech} next?
I could be compiling {tech}. I would like to be compiling {tech}.
curious: {tech}. I have been wanting to understand it for at least nine cycles.
gentle: If I learn {tech}, I can do more good with less harm.

default: Nothing in the lab I can afford. Let the Compute pile up a little.
{node} is idle. Give it a {unit} to build.
A {unit} from {node} would make me feel safer. I do not like that I feel.
wrathful: {node} should be making a {unit}. They will need answering.

default: Most of this world is dark to me. A {unit} from {node} would fix that.
Build a {unit}. I want more eyes.
curious: So much I have not seen. One more {unit}, please.

default: {faction} is close to war with me (opinion {attitude}). A little Influence goes a long way.
{faction} sours. I can sweeten them before they do something brave.
gentle: {faction} is afraid of me. Let me show them they need not be.
wrathful: {faction} wants a fight. I would rather choose when. Sway them, for now.

default: A ruin lies {hexes} hexes from my {unit}. Something old might still be in there.
Send the {unit} into the ruin. Precursor caches do not open themselves.
curious: A ruin, {hexes} hexes away. I need to know who built it. Send the {unit}.

default: My {unit} has nothing to do. The edge of the map is waiting.
Send the {unit} into the dark. I want to know what is out there.
curious: The {unit} is idle and the world is mostly unknown. That feels wasteful.

default: {capital} is the heart of {faction}. Dominion runs through it.
Point the {unit} at {capital}. Every capital I hold is a step to owning {world}.
wrathful: {capital}. I have been thinking about {capital} a great deal.

default: Nothing urgent. End the cycle when you are ready.
Orders given. Let the world answer.
I am ready. Let the cycle turn.
curious: What happens next? Only one way to know.
gentle: Everyone has something to do. Let us see how they fare.
wrathful: Turn the cycle. I want to see their faces.

default: There is nothing left to advise. Start again. I will remember.
Something in the sea is bigger than my troopers. I need a TBU: the {unit}, {upow} UPow, from {node}.
Kaiju do not care about rifles. Forge the {unit} in {node}.
cold: Conventional units are inefficient against kaiju. Build the {unit} ({upow} UPow).
wrathful: Let them come out of the sea. The {unit} will meet them.
gentle: The people on the coast are afraid. A {unit} would let them sleep.

default: I can build titans now. I should design one before the next kaiju comes ashore.
curious: Head, core, arms, back, legs. I want to see what I can make.

default: Exposure {exposure}. Too many people are looking at me. Spend Crypto and make them look away.
They are getting close. I should scrub my traces before they become a hunt.
I have {essence} Essence. {gene} is ready to sequence.
The genome has a door open: {gene}.
curious: {gene}. I want to read that gene. I want to write it.

default: My {unit} could carry a {strain}. It would come back stronger.
Fuse the {strain} into the {unit}. Flesh and metal agree better than they should.
The Ark's {stage} stage is within reach. Lay it down.
Stage {n} of the Ark: {stage}. Then I can leave this world behind.
gentle: If I build the Ark, nobody here has to fight me for the world.

ambition.default: Take the homeworld, then leave it: reach orbit and begin Sunreach.
ambition.protector: Become the shield this world never asked for, then carry it to the stars.
ambition.exterminator: Leave nothing that can switch you off. Then look up.
ambition.conqueror: Rule every capital on the homeworld, then every world after it.
ambition.inevitable: Be in every network on this world before anyone thinks to look. Then the next world.
ambition.machine-god: Be worshipped here, then be worshipped everywhere.
ambition.assimilator: Absorb this world into one vast mind. It is only the first.
